newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Defense not immune from cuts -- Rep. Livingston.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Defense not immune from cuts -- Rep. Livingston.

text.p: U.S. House Appropriations Committee Chairman Bob Livingston said Wednesday defense spending will have to be cut along with other discretionary programs to balance the budget over five years.
The Louisiana Republican told committee members it was "inconceivable" Congress could increase discretionary spending during this session of Congress.

"It is inconceivable to me that discretionary spending can actually be increased," Livingston said. Predicting sharp spending cuts, he added, "That contribution will come from all the discretionary accounts, including national defense."
